🚀 Project 1 — Credit Card Fraud Detection:

    (Type: Classification, Imbalanced Data)

    Dataset: Credit Card Fraud Detection Dataset

    🎯 Goal

        Detect whether a transaction is fraud (1) or normal (0)

    🔴 Real Challenge

        Dataset is highly imbalanced:
        
        Normal → 99%
        Fraud → 1%

        👉 Accuracy alone is misleading
        👉 We focus on precision, recall

🧾 Resume Line

Built a fraud detection model using Random Forest with class balancing and evaluated using precision-recall metrics.


🚀 Project 2 — Customer Churn Prediction

    (Type: Classification, Business Use Case)
    
    Dataset: Telco Customer Churn Dataset
    
    🎯 Goal
    
        Predict whether a customer will leave (churn)

🧾 Resume Line

Developed a customer churn prediction model using Random Forest and performed feature engineering on telecom data.
